q_01.name: Brick-Walled Railway Cutting
q_01.why: Steel rails and wooden sleepers run between tall brick walls under an open sky.
q_01.odd: The far end is very dark, and the wall signs are hard to read.

q_02.name: Train station
q_02.why: Two sets of tracks run beside a green-striped train and a covered platform.
q_02.odd: The platform interior is too dark to make out clearly.

q_03.name: Brick-walled industrial walkway
q_03.why: A gray tiled walkway runs beside red brick walls, with metal machinery visible below on the left.
q_03.odd: The dark recess in the right wall is hard to make out.

q_04.name: Crate storage room
q_04.why: Three wooden crates sit on a stone-tiled floor beneath a plank ceiling.
q_04.odd: Dim lighting obscures some wall detail.

q_05.name: Dining room
q_05.why: Two high-backed chairs flank a wooden table, with a grandfather clock against the back wall.
q_05.odd: The small framed picture is too dark to make out.

q_06.name: Industrial station interior
q_06.why: Brick walls, riveted steel columns, wooden counters, and a tiled floor frame a long room.
q_06.odd: Deep shadows make the far wall and doorways hard to read.

q_07.name: Bar interior
q_07.why: Bottles sit on a wooden counter beside red stools, with small tables along the back wall.
q_07.odd: Two hooded figures appear to overlap beside a stool.

q_08.name: Wood-paneled corridor
q_08.why: Wood-paneled walls, ceiling beams, and patterned carpet frame a narrow passage.
q_08.odd: The hanging strips along the walls are hard to identify.

q_09.name: Brick Wall With Barred Window
q_09.why: A red brick wall frames an open doorway and a recessed window with iron bars.
q_09.odd: The small symbol on the wall panel is hard to identify.

q_10.name: Storage room
q_10.why: Wooden crates and a barrel sit against the walls of a dim, enclosed room.
q_10.odd: A wide black border surrounds the small view, and the bottom edge is barely readable.

q_11.name: Brick-walled train platform
q_11.why: A locomotive with a smokestack and red wheels sits beside a stone walkway with a barrel.
q_11.odd: The wheels are partly hidden below the platform edge.

q_12.name: Steam locomotive in a rail yard
q_12.why: Large spoked wheels and a connecting rod sit beneath a rust-colored body, with flames behind it.
q_12.odd: The locomotive’s upper body is cropped, and the background is very dark.

q_13.name: Steam locomotive at a platform
q_13.why: A tall smokestack and large wheels sit above rails beside a stone platform.
q_13.odd: A horned skull decorates the locomotive’s front.

q_14.name: Rusted door in industrial corridor
q_14.why: A rust-orange door with a metal handle and barred window stands along a green-striped wall.
q_14.odd: The barred window is too dark to see through.

q_15.name: Moonlit wooden walkway
q_15.why: Wooden planks run alongside a metal-clad wall, with a low railing and the moon overhead.
q_15.odd: The opening at the far end is too dark to make out.

q_16.name: Rail depot shutter doors
q_16.why: Rusty tracks and wooden ties lead toward tall, ribbed metal panels framed by brickwork.
q_16.odd: The rails appear to end flush against the shutters.

q_17.name: Pillar-lined walkway
q_17.why: Gray pillars divide recessed brown bays beneath a low ceiling, with a curb running across the foreground.
q_17.odd: The bright green strip blends into the pillar bases, making the ground and walls hard to distinguish.

q_18.name: Ornate iron gate
q_18.why: Tall iron bars with curved motifs block a stone passage, with green liquid visible beyond.
q_18.odd: The dim lighting makes the wooden objects beyond the gate hard to identify.

q_19.name: Wooden bench in brick room
q_19.why: A broad plank seat and upright backrest sit in front of a dark brick wall.
q_19.odd: The dim lighting makes the small framed wall details hard to read.
